review_candidates.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Observability
review_candidates.description: About The Opportunity We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to join the Observability group inside our Platform Engineering domain. Platform Engineering’s goal is to provide easy to use, self-service platforms to enable other segments to easily build, deploy and monitor their business applications. And Observability’s role in that part of the company is to provide our users with end-to-end observability that’s easy to use. As one of the first banks completely hosted in the cloud, our security, resilience and productivity standards require a motivated and well balanced team. We are using a modern technology stack to match our principles when it comes to providing the framework for our development team, the company and our customers. In This Role, You Will In Observability you’ll build the tools for monitoring and measuring infrastructure, microservices, and sometimes totally unique workloads. You’ll put the developer experience at the front of your mind and implementations, and you’ll contribute deeply to understanding and preventing incidents through tooling, automation, and people-centered processes. All the while you’ll be thinking like an engineer. That means using automation to speed up repetitive tasks and to contribute to the security and compliance of the tech stack that you run and support. What You Need To Be Successful You need to be well-versed in the basics building blocks of observability: metrics, logs, and traces. You should also be familiar with the tools we need to extract (think things like Prometheus, StatsD, OpenTelemetry libraries), transform (tools like Vector, Beats, FluentBit), and load (OpenSearch, Grafana, etc.) this data in ways that your fellow engineers can make sense of it. Then, you should be comfortable with helping your colleagues understand this data so they can measure and monitor their applications and recover quickly for incidents.. Next, you’ll need experience with at least one glue language like GoLang or Python. And you’ll need to operate like your brain runs on Linux. Everything we do is in the cloud, so it’s important that you like it, understand it, and know what it takes to observe it. Your entire environment, from provisioning to deployment, will be defined and managed as code using tools like Terraform and AWS CDK. Finally, things change fast here. We like it that way! Even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria for this job, but you should have a strong desire to learn and improve, and you have a passion for working with bleeding-edge technologies, then you’d be a great asset to our team. Bullet points version Understanding of the basic building blocks of observability: metrics, logs, and traces Experience using the right tools to extract data (think things like Prometheus, StatsD, OpenTelemetry libraries), transform data (tools like Vector, Beats, FluentBit), and load data (OpenSearch, Grafana, Datadog, etc.) so that your fellow engineers can make sense of it Solid skills with at least one glue language like GoLang or Python The ability to build in a cloud-only environment with with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform and AWS CDK A brain that runs on Linux What’s In It For You Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who We Are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. Sounds good? Apply now for this position. Equal Opportunities We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential. We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com. Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

review_candidates.title: Human Resources Executive
review_candidates.description: 📢 We're Hiring: HR Executive 📍 ideas International Secondary School, Kuala Lumpur 📅 Start Date: September 2026 Are you an experienced HR professional who is confident in managing employee matters, HR processes, and employment compliance? Do you enjoy working in a diverse, mission-driven environment where people are at the heart of the organisation? If so, ideas International Secondary School invites you to apply! About Us Ideas International Secondary School is a non-profit secondary school in Kuala Lumpur providing quality, affordable education to refugee and underserved youth. We empower students to become changemakers in their communities through holistic, learner-centered education. Position Summary We are seeking a proactive and experienced HR Executive to take responsibility for the school's HR functions and serve as the main point of contact for employees and management on HR-related matters. The role will oversee the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, employment contracts, leave and attendance, performance management, employee relations, HR documentation, and offboarding. The position will also be responsible for ensuring that HR practices and employment documentation comply with applicable Malaysian employment legislation and statutory requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, employment changes, contract renewals, reappointments, and offboarding. Act as the main point of contact for employees and management on HR-related matters, providing appropriate guidance and support. Prepare, review, and maintain employment contracts, reappointment letters, job descriptions, HR policies, and other employment-related documentation. Ensure employment contracts and HR practices comply with the Employment Act 1955 and other applicable Malaysian employment legislation. Monitor compliance with statutory requirements relating to working hours, rest days, public holidays, annual leave, sick leave, maternity leave, paternity leave, termination, and other employee entitlements under applicable employment legislation. Maintain accurate records relating to employee attendance, leave, sick leave, holidays, contracts, and other employment matters. Ensure proper and timely maintenance of statutory employee records and documentation required under Malaysian employment regulations. Coordinate and monitor statutory employment obligations, including EPF (KWSP), SOCSO, and other applicable statutory requirements , in coordination with the Finance Manager and relevant authorities. Support accurate employee payroll information and ensure that changes to salary, allowances, leave, deductions, and employment status are properly communicated and recorded. Coordinate recruitment activities, including preparing and posting vacancies, arranging interviews, communicating with candidates, and supporting the selection process. Ensure appropriate HR documentation and onboarding processes are completed for new employees, including required access and employment records. Coordinate annual staff appraisal processes in collaboration with relevant Heads of Department. Manage employee feedback and engagement processes, including staff surveys and reporting. Support employee relations matters, including addressing workplace concerns, disciplinary matters, grievances, and other employee issues in accordance with company policies and applicable employment requirements. Maintain strict confidentiality and appropriate handling of employee personal data and sensitive HR information. Keep up to date with changes to Malaysian employment legislation, statutory requirements, and HR best practices, and advise management where HR policies or practices require review or adjustment. Coordinate staff learning and development initiatives and liaise with external training providers and partners. Coordinate volunteer onboarding, offboarding, and related HR records. Support staff engagement and wellbeing initiatives, including work anniversaries, birthdays, team activities, and end-of-term celebrations. Liaise with the Finance Manager and relevant external agencies on HR and statutory matters when required. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of relevant HR experience , preferably with experience managing HR functions independently. Strong working knowledge of Malaysian employment legislation and statutory HR requirements . Good knowledge of the Employment Act 1955 , including employee entitlements, working hours, leave, contracts, termination, and other employment conditions. Working knowledge of EPF (KWSP), SOCSO, and other applicable statutory employment requirements . Experience preparing and managing employment contracts, HR policies, employee records, and other HR documentation. Experience handling recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and offboarding. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive employee matters professionally. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Strong ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive employee information. Ability to work independently, take ownership of HR processes, and advise management on HR-related matters. Positive, proactive, and growth-oriented mindset. Competent in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. A team player who can collaborate effectively with colleagues, volunteers, school leadership, and external partners. Experience working in a diverse, multicultural, or educational environment is an advantage. Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion and to supporting the school's mission of providing education to refugee and underserved youth. What We Offer A meaningful and rewarding opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven educational organisation. A supportive and collaborative working environment. Opportunities for professional development and learning. The opportunity to work with a diverse and multicultural school community. Competitive local salary (commensurate with experience). How to Apply Please send your CV and a short cover letter to shahr.banoo@ideas.edu.my with the subject line: Application – HR Executive . Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
